turns.replyText:
I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.
We completely understand why quality and proven standards matter, especially if you've been disappointed by other devices in the past.
Theradome is engineered to the highest clinical standards to ensure real, reliable results:
• 100% Medical-Grade Lasers: Unlike many competitors that use cheap LEDs (light-emitting diodes) or a mix of LEDs and lasers, Theradome uses 100% proprietary red lasers at a 680 nm wavelength. Lasers provide coherent light that penetrates 3–5 mm deep into the scalp to energize the mitochondria of hair follicles, whereas LEDs produce scattered light that barely reaches below the scalp surface.
• Made in the USA & Engineered by Experts: Theradome is engineered in Silicon Valley by scientists and a former NASA laser expert, ensuring strict U.S. manufacturing quality and safety.
• Precision Heat Management & Dosage: Our exclusive IntelliDose™ system delivers an optimal dose of 6.09 Joules/cm² while keeping temperature rise under 1°F using a 24K gold heat sink, avoiding excess heat that can cause shedding.
• Clinical Proof & Risk-Free Guarantee: In double-blind clinical trials, laser therapy was proven to grow hair while LED placebo devices failed to show improvement. We stand behind our quality with a 6-month money-back guarantee so you can try it risk-free.
